subject: Annual Prepay: release cadence & drawdown exception tracker
messages:
From: Samantha Rhodes <samantha.rhodes@orionhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Liu <mark.liu@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Annual Prepay plan — release cadence & exceptional drawdowns

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We’ve agreed internally to a $600k committed prepay for Redwood inference capacity for 2026. Procurement asked me to lock the invoicing and drawdown process before the PO is routed. A few things we need to document:

- Preferred invoicing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether Redwood will do a periodic sweep against the committed balance.
- How exceptional drawdowns are handled (e.g., sudden burst consumption beyond committed rate). Who authorizes emergency top-ups?
- VAT and taxing details — we operate in multiple EU entities and need invoices that include correct VAT numbers or show net amounts depending on the country.
- Remit/bank details, and a single source of truth tracker (a sheet we can update).

I attached the PO (Orion_PO_2025.pdf) for reference. Can you share a proposed schedule and a simple tracker template we can use to reconcile drawdowns? Procurement would like this as part of the PO package.

Would appreciate looping in your billing lead or ops contact. Cc’ing Mark (tax/procurement) to keep him in the loop.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Rhodes
Head of Procurement, Orion Health
Attachments: Orion_PO_2025.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Rhodes <samantha.rhodes@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual Prepay plan — release cadence & exceptional drawdowns

Hi Samantha — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. Attaching a lightweight tracker + template that other customers have used: redwood_prepay_template.xlsx.

Quick proposal (can adjust):
- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices showing gross and VAT line where applicable; we will do a quarterly sweep to reconcile committed balance vs actual consumption and issue a credit or additional invoice if needed.
- Exceptional drawdowns: any sustained >30% above committed run-rate for >48 hours triggers an automated alert to both teams; emergency one-off bursts are billed at overage rates unless pre-approved by Orion procurement (email approval is sufficient).
- VAT: we will populate VAT fields on invoice according to the legal entity and VAT ID you provide; for EU customers where reverse charge applies we will show net amounts and reference the VAT ID on the invoice.
- Remit: please confirm the remit bank and entity for Orion (Mark?) so we can include eight-digit reference on each invoice for auto-applies.

Next steps:
1) Mark and procurement confirm VAT entity/IDs for each country.
2) We finalize cadence and add final schedule to the PO package.
3) Redwood billing ops (Kim and Priyom cc’d) will produce the first invoice on Jan 1 if we sign by Dec 1.

I’ve put Priyom as the ops owner and Kim as billing lead.

Cheers,
Naomi
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_prepay_template.xlsx
From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@orionhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Annual Prepay plan — release cadence & exceptional drawdowns

Thanks Naomi / Samantha — quick clarifications from tax/procurement:  

- Orion has two EU VAT registrations relevant here: Orion Health UK Ltd (GB999999999) and Orion Health EU (IE1234567H). For services delivered to the EU entity, we generally expect net invoices under reverse-charge where applicable.
- We'll attach a copy of our VAT certs to the PO; see attached Orion_tax_registration.pdf.
- On the point about sweeping vs monthly: Procurement prefers monthly invoices for cash flow but wants a quarterly committed-balance reconciliation to avoid surprises.
- For exceptional drawdowns: Procurement will provide written approval for any committed-increase or emergency top-up; Mark (me) or Samantha will sign off. Please include a one-line invoice reference field so our AP system auto-applies credits against the committed bucket.

One ask: can Redwood produce a short CSV export from your tracker that our AP team can upload directly (columns: invoice_ref, invoice_date, amount_gross, amount_vat, committed_bucket_balance_after)? That will speed reconciliation.

Mark
Mark Liu
Senior Manager, Procurement — Orion Health
Attachments: Orion_tax_registration.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual Prepay plan — release cadence & exceptional drawdowns

Naomi / Priyom / Samantha — taking the ops side. Attached is an initial invoice-window-matrix.csv that maps invoice dates to committed-balance checkpoints and a proposed exception approval flow. High level:

- Invoice cadence: monthly on the 1st of each month (invoice covers prior month consumption).
- Quarterly reconciliation: on the 1st business day after quarter close we run the committed-balance sweep and generate any credit/debit memo.
- Emergency top-ups: procurement email approval -> billing ops issues one-off invoice; if approval not received within 24 hours but usage persists, we will notify and hold the charge in a pending state for 7 days before invoicing.

Kimbo (cc’d) is included in the CSV; the file also includes the CSV header format that Mark asked for (invoice_ref, invoice_date, amount_gross, amount_vat, committed_bucket_balance_after).

Related links: HubSpot deal link added to the matrix for reconciliation and a placeholder DocuSign template.

Thanks — happy to tweak the header mapping if Mark’s AP needs different field names.

—Kimberly
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice-window-matrix.csv

Subject: Re: Annual Prepay plan — release cadence & exceptional drawdowns

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed items and next steps (finalized schedule below). Quoting prior notes where useful.

Summary (agreed):
- Invoicing cadence: Monthly invoices on the 1st (covering prior month).
- Quarterly reconciliation: Sweep run the 2nd business day after quarter close; Redwood will issue credit/debit memos as necessary.
- Exceptional drawdowns: Procurement approval required to convert usage into committed-bucket increases; emergency bursts without approval will be held pending for up to 7 days, then invoiced at overage rates if not disputed.
- VAT handling: Redwood invoices will include VAT lines per entity. For EU reverse-charge cases we will show net amounts and include the Orion VAT ID you provided (GB999999999 / IE1234567H).
- CSV export: billing ops will publish the monthly CSV in the format Mark requested.
- Remit: Orion to confirm final remit account for AP auto-apply; once provided, Redwood will include the invoice_ref token on every invoice.

Action items:
1) Mark: confirm final remit bank + AP contact (by 2025-11-25).
2) Naomi/Priyom: we will load the redwood_prepay_template.xlsx into billing ops as the canonical tracker and will publish a monthly CSV export to the HubSpot deal link.
3) Kimberly: attach the invoice-window-matrix.csv and produce the first sample CSV for Jan invoice by 2025-12-15.
4) Samantha: attach signed PO to the HubSpot record after you circulate internally.

I attached the finalized schedule CSV and a tiny remit instructions stub to use for AP (20251119-final-invoice-schedule.csv, remit_instructions.txt). If that looks good I’ll push the DocuSign order and schedule the first invoice for Jan 1 billing.

Thanks all — short thread, big impact.

Best,
Naomi
